source_title: ODOT Special Hauling Permits — OS-1A Limitations/Provisions (Rev 01/18) + OS-8 Legal Dimension & Weight Limits (Rev 01/19); fees per OAC 5501:2-1-10 (ORC 5577.04/.05)
verify_reasons: Legal limits and the full escort/pilot matrix are sourced from official ODOT documents fetched this run (OS-1A Rev 01/18 and OS-8 Rev 01/19), which reproduce ORC 5577.04/.05.

Single-trip and annual fees are from secondary compliance summaries of OAC 5501:2-1-10 — the official ODOT fee-rule PDF (registerofohio) and the ODOT permit-fee pages refused the connection (ECONNREFUSED/404) this run; confirm current dollar amounts via the Ohio Hauling Permit System before dispatch.

Superload gross-weight trigger (~120,000 lbs) and structural-review tier (>250,000 lbs → ODOT Office of Structural Engineering) are secondary; the 14'/14'6" dimensional superload breaks are corroborated by the official ODOT fee and escort tiers.

superload_thresholds.note: Over 14' wide or 14'6" high (official ODOT fee/escort tier breaks), or ~120,000 lbs gross (secondary — official op-guide page unreachable) triggers special/superload review by the ODOT Special Hauling Permit Section. Loads up to 250,000 lbs analyzed in-house; over 250,000 lbs forwarded to the ODOT Office of Structural Engineering. No fixed published length superload trigger (null).

width.note: 1 escort over 13' wide — lead on 2-lane, becomes rear escort on multilane highways (ODOT OS-1A)

height.note: 1 lead escort equipped with a height-sensing device over 14'6" high (OS-1A)
1 lead + 1 rear escort over 14'10" high; move must be coordinated with overhead sign/signal/utility owners (OS-1A)

single_trip.fee_formula: Single-trip fees per OAC 5501:2-1-10 (official rule PDF unreachable this run; figures from secondary compliance summaries): oversize up to 14' wide / 14'6" high approx $55 (return trip ~$35), over that approx $125; overweight up to 120,000 lbs approx $125, over 120,000 lbs base + ~$0.04/ton/mile on the excess. Basic processing ~$10-$20. Confirm current amounts via the Ohio Hauling Permit System.
single_trip.note: Overweight is axle-based: single 20,000 / tandem 34,000 lbs, groups by Federal Bridge Formula; a >2,000 lb overage on a granted axle/group does not void the permit (OS-1A). Fee amounts are secondary/uncodified here.

annual.note: Annual/blanket permits available (secondary: oversize ~$960/yr, overweight ~$1,960/yr per OAC 5501:2-1-10); confirm via portal.

movement_restrictions: Over-dimensional loads: daylight-only movement, one-half hour before sunrise to one-half hour after sunset (OS-1A). Non-oversize overweight loads have no day/hour restriction if they do not obstruct traffic flow.

Loads over 12' wide: metro rush-hour ban 6:30-9:00 a.m. and 4:30-6:00 p.m. Mon-Fri in 22 named urban counties (incl. Franklin, Cuyahoga, Hamilton, Montgomery, Summit, Lucas, Stark, Mahoning, Lorain, Butler, Warren, Clermont).
Loads over 12' wide: weekend movement bans (Fri/Sat/Sun afternoon into next sunrise), April 1-Nov 30 (OS-1A).
Holiday bans (New Year's, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas): from noon the day preceding until one-half hour before sunrise the day after.
Mobile/manufactured structures prohibited when wind exceeds 25 mph on roadway or 15 mph on bridges.
notes: Legal width 8'6", height 13'6" (confirmed, NOT 14'), gross 80,000 lbs; tractor-semitrailer 53'. Axle limits: single 20,000 / tandem 34,000 lbs, groups per Federal Bridge Formula W = 500[(LN/(N-1)) + 12N + 36] (ORC 5577.04).

Escort matrix and legal limits sourced from official ODOT OS-1A/OS-8 fetched 2026-07-16. Fees and superload gross trigger are secondary (official ODOT fee/op-guide pages refused the connection this run). State-level rules only — county/city permits and bridge-specific engineering are out of scope.
